description: [Kyreos, 0.003 USDC per call via x402 on Base] One call: live USDC (ERC-20) balance of any Base address, plus latest block number and gas price, read at a stated block. Cheaper than chaining an ETH-balance read and a gas read. No tx receipts. Input: {"address":"0x..."}. HTTP: GET https://store.agentexchange.work/w/base-chain-batch?q=... Call once without x_payment to get the x402 payment terms (0.003 USDC); call again with x_payment (the signed x402 payment) to get the result.

x_payment.description: base64 x402 payment payload for the terms returned on the first call (0.003 USDC on Base)
